image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a slice of meatloaf served on a white plate with a silver rim. The meatloaf slice has a textured, browned crust and a lighter, dense interior visible at the cut edge. It is topped with a glossy, dark reddish-brown glaze that appears to be tomato-based or barbecue sauce, which has pooled slightly on the plate. A fork rests in the background, partially out of focus. The lighting is warm, suggesting an indoor dining setting.
